title: Prove source-bound numerical lifetimes for BIT Layout
body:
## Summary

PR2810 leaves the preceding `Layout.extents` phase outside its numerical allowance. This source-bound proof and replay package closes that component for the unchanged PR2697 two-bank Layout.

```text
adapter action
  Layout.extents: at most 6 extra residues / 4 extra indices
  restore numerical entry residents
  ADD: retain the inherited conditional allowance
```

The constructor peaks at four indices and retains three. Unary extents need three indices; physical maps and complete fibres have separate exact bounds. Under PR2801/2810's pinned contracts, preceding extents fit inside their existing `(37672,34)` adapter allowance because the scratch lifetimes are successive.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2810 explicitly excludes Layout construction/extents. **After:** the written source proof, 45 fixtures and 555 literal extent calls establish this component's lifetime constants, exact cardinalities/gap placement and successful restoration.
- Nine optimized controls cover one-Word undercharging, omitted powers, leaked indices, zero exponents, source integrity, typed receipts and the exception boundary. Registered Python 3.12, optimized Python 3.14, relocated read-only replay and scoped Ruff checks pass. A separate internal reviewer rederived the bounds, ran the checker/controls and verified all eleven source exports against their exact Git bytes.
- [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18960449). Started from canonical main `d9b248311`, priority 5; submission refresh and overlap are recorded in TASK.json.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697 implementation, Nick Petalas's PR2759/2801 lifetime components and Ross Richardson's PR2810 handoff; full predecessor notices are preserved. The scope is explicitly changed from a complete stock envelope to this pending BIT caller component. Initialization/validation, child and non-ADD phases, physical banks/movement and supplier admission remain open. No new kappa or selected cold replay is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One opt-in package; selected records and frozen predecessors are unchanged.
